bacterial_source_query.selection_rule: Include every eligible assembly through the first UTC census date satisfying the prospective accrual thresholds.
bacterial_source_query.if_threshold_not_met: Repeat the identical census weekly and extend only forward in time. Do not move the release boundary backward.

phage_source_query.if_threshold_not_met: Accrue prospectively using the same rule; do not substitute previously inspected phage rows for primary confirmation.

ground_truth.bacterial_replicons: NCBI sequence-report assigned molecule location type.
ground_truth.ambiguous_replicons: Retain in the audit inventory but exclude from primary scoring before predictions are generated.
ground_truth.phage_label: Eligible complete bacteriophage RefSeq genome accession.

biological_group: assembly accession or independent viral genome source

window_policy.short_replicon_policy: A replicon contributes only to fragment lengths not exceeding its sequence length.
window_policy.cross_length_overlap: Allowed because each length is evaluated separately; pooled uncertainty remains clustered by biological source.

source_population_fragments.purpose: Primary fragment evaluation preserving eligible replicon composition under the declared per-replicon cap
source_population_fragments.precision_interpretation: Precision applies to this explicitly sampled cohort, not to arbitrary metagenomic prevalence.

balanced_diagnostic_fragments.sampling: Balance plasmid and chromosome windows within each fixed length after applying source and replicon caps.
balanced_diagnostic_fragments.precision_interpretation: Diagnostic benchmark precision only; not deployment PPV.

phage_three_class.requirement: Phage positives and bacterial negatives must all be frozen before predictions are inspected.

W1_length_standardized.purpose: Reweight class-conditional performance to the observed W1 contig-length distribution.
W1_length_standardized.restriction: W1 supplies length weights only and supplies no truth labels.

training_near_duplicate.action: exclude from primary cohort and retain in audit appendix

training_close_relative.action: retain but report in a predefined known/close stratum

tool_reference_database_match.action: Do not selectively exclude. Assign reference-known and reference-novel strata and report separately.

blindness_rule: No PlasFlow2 or comparator predictions may be generated until selection, truth labels, exclusions, window manifests, hashes and scoring adapters are frozen.
